label: coach_teacher_home_first_00
text: I have arrived.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_first_01
text: You may call me Mr. Saguaro.\c\nI look forward to working with you.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So it WAS you who called me here, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_01
text: I had heard that an extraordinary exchange\nstudent making a name for themselves here was\r\ntasked with gathering talent.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_02
text: I was curious to see what kind of student could\nearn such high renown, but well... Now that I\r\nfind you here, it all makes sense.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_select_01
text: Thank you!

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_select_02
text: I know, right?

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_03
text: Heh... You do not hide your talent, do you? A\nkey to your success, no doubt.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_03b
text: Heh... You have a sense of humor about all this,\ndon’t you? A key to your success, no doubt.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_04
text: Seeing a student of mine achieve such great\nthings brings me joy.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_05
text: I’ll do my best here to try and match your own\naccomplishments.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_01
text: You see, I recently decided to get a case for my\nRotom Phone.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_02
text: Now, tell me... Did I put it on right?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_select_01
text: Looks good!

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_select_02
text: Cute case!

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_select_03
text: Arven has that case!

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_03
text: Thank goodness! This is the very first time I’ve\nattempted something like this...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_03b
text: Oh! So you think so as well?! I’m also very fond\nof this case![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_03c
text: Oh? So we have matching cases now, it seems...\nThat boy Arven’s got quite good taste.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_04
text:
I searched everywhere to get my hands on it,
you know.\c
As it turns out, the Flabébé Flower Case is sold
only in Cascarrafa.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_05
text: I’m quite pleased that I was able to find it in\nthe end.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_00
text: Allow me to share some good information with\nyou, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_01
text: You can find the Cream Pokémon Milcery in\nthe Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_02
text: Not only is it adorable, but it also emits a\nsweet fragrance. It’s hard to put into words\r\njust how lovely it is...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_03
text: Are you aware of the peculiar way in which one\ngets Milcery to evolve?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_select_01
text: By spinning around

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_select_02
text: By calling it cute

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_select_03
text: By feeding it something sweet

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_04
text: That is indeed correct. Have you by chance tried\nthis yourself already?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_04b
text: Well, yes, telling your Pokémon how cute it is\nwill put you both in a lovely mood, but it’s\r\nnot going to evolve from that.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_04c
text: Oh, that’d be lovely if it evolved by eating a\ntasty Peanut Butter Sandwich...\c\nBut, alas, I don’t think that’s ever happened.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_05
text: If you want a Milcery to evolve, put it in your\nparty and spin around a few times.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_06
text: When you do that, its cream gets whisked around\nand causes it to become a fluffy Alcremie.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_07
text: But don’t forget to have your Milcery hold onto\na Sweet item before you attempt this![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_08
text: And be aware that Alcremie’s form will change\ndepending on the Sweet it was holding, as well as\r\nthe way you spin around.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_09
text: To get my Alcremie looking the way she does, I\nhad to fine-tune my spin with absolute precision![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_00
text: You know, the only reason I was able to meet my\nAlcremie was because you called me here.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_01
text: You must have met plenty of wonderful Pokémon\non your travels, no?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_02
text: Why don’t we trade? A Pokémon from you could\ndo much to enlighten me about your journey.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_03
text: Hmmm... I’ll trade my Hattrem. What about you,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Yes, I feel like I have a newfound appreciation
for all the adventures you’ve been on.\c
I thank you for the trade, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, you’d like to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for
my
Hattrem,
yes?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Mr. Saguaro a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Mr. Saguaro such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Mr. Saguaro a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_03_00
text:
...Ah. Sorry, I’m afraid we can’t trade if you’ve
only got one Pokémon with you.\c
Why don’t we try this again once you have at
least two in your party?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_03_01
text: Just let me know when you’d like to trade.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_trade_04_00
text: Would you like to trade with me?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_talkto_00
text: Oh? Are you interested in battling me,\nChampion?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_cancel_00
text: I’m quite ready for a battle. Just let me know\nwhen.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_battlestart_00
text: Yes, of course, let’s battle. I won’t hold back.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_00
text: Hmmm, I thought I had trained plenty enough...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_01
text: But I should expect no less from a Champion.\nYour potential for growth is unparalleled.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_02
text: You must be tired after battling. Take these.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_03
text: Sour foods do wonders for exhaustion.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_reward_00
text: [EMPTY 66]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_01_00
text: My, no matter how many battles we have, they\nnever cease to be sweet.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_01_01
text: Thank you for asking me to battle.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_lose_00_00
text:
It isn’t like you to lose like that. You seemed...
distracted?\c
Be sure to take care of yourself and show your
Pokémon some love.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_00
text: My class here is quite popular—it’s about healthy\nmeals to feed Pokémon after battles. Why don’t\r\nyou join us sometime?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_01
text:
Don’t you think it remarkable that rain falls in the
Terarium?\c
One can have their picnic spoiled by a sudden
downpour there, just like anywhere else.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_02
text:
Have you tried the Academy Shake? You can
order it in the cafeteria.\c
It’s so sweet it’ll make your tongue go numb.
It’s hard not to smile when you drink it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] positively gleams! You
must
have
given it a carefully balanced diet, no?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_04
text: How is the Hattrem I traded you faring? Her\ncuteness really is unmatched, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
